newsitem.title: USA: Integrated knows no reason for decline.
newsitem.headline: Integrated knows no reason for decline.

text.p: Integrated Marketing Professionals Inc said Thursday that the company is "unaware of any reason" for the sharp decline in the price of its stock.
In a release Thursday, the company said that Integrated shares closed Wednesday at $1.06, down 79 percent from their closing price of $5 on September 13.
Integrated also said that it expects to report a profit from continuing operations of more than $600,000 for the year ending December 31, 1996.
An Integrated executive said the company "should be significantly profitable in 1997 and beyond."
